Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch Dashboard for Lambda-based API Health Monitoring

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the API for dashboard labeling
    Default: MyLambdaAPI
  
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Lambda function to monitor
  
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard
    Default: !Sub '${ApiName}-Health-Dashboard'

Resources:
  LambdaHealthDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  ["AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}"]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Invocations",
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Sum"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  ["AWS/Lambda", "Errors", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}"]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Errors",
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Sum"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  ["AWS/Lambda", "Throttles", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}"]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Throttles",
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Sum"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  ["AWS/Lambda", "Duration", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}"]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Average Duration (ms)",
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Average"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ { "expression": "IF(invocations > 0, 100 - (errors/invocations)*100, 100)", "label": "Success Rate (%)", "id": "success_rate" } ],
                  [ "AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "id": "invocations", "visible": false } ],
                  [ "AWS/Lambda", "Errors", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "id": "errors", "visible": false } ]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Success Rate (%)",
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Average",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0,
                    "max": 100
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  DashboardUrl:
    Description: URL to access the CloudWatch Dashboard
    Value: !Sub 'https://console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${DashboardName}'
